TECTUS reaches the pinnacle in both design and technology, adhering to the architectural design principle of minimalism to perfection. Thanks to its flush and linear design, the completely concealed hinge system seamlessly integrates with almost any material, making for a uniform appearance within the architecture.
TECTUS - excellence in design and technology

The clearer and more reduced the design principle, the greater the requirements are in terms of precision and perfection. Hinge systems from the TECTUS brand create a perfect, detailed starting point for this purpose.

TECTUS Energy - with permanent energy transfer

With TECTUS Energy, the door leaf of rebated and unrebated residential, heavy-duty and entrance doors are secured and continuously supplied with energy from the frame side. The various connection technologies are compatible with all conventional locking and fitting designs, while still maintaining the flush room design aesthetic.
TECTUS Glass – the concealed hinge system for glass doors

With the TECTUS Glass hinge system, glass doors along with the frame and hinge and latching systems lie completely flush on the same plane. This gives interior room concepts with generous glazing a degree of subtlety, transparency and lightness not achieved until this point. Besides achieving highest level of open design in terms of aesthetics, the integrated system ensures maximum acoustic protection within private residential buildings and various office designs in the commercial sector.

Flush surfaces are more of a characterising aspect in architecture in every kind of typology than ever. To this end, the hinge system from the TECTUS brand for unrebated and flush-rebated doors are perfect for forming a flat plane when closed.
, in which the frame part is offset relative to the door part, makes it possible to integrate a door with a concealed hinge into the door environment, rendering the frame invisible.

The impressive variety of finishes allows the hinge system from the TECTUS brand to be used in a range of applications. They can be coordinated with the architectural design and fittings, remaining entirely concealed in the background when the door is shut. Moreover, choosing contrasting colours makes for unique accents and emphasises particular design elements.

The availability of different load capacities and sizes allows the hinge system from the TECTUS brand to be used in a wide range of applications – from residential and heavy-duty doors to timber entrance doors. Even variations with intumescent kits such as
and designs with integrated energy transfer such as
are possible. All models have a uniform appearance and a closed hinge body.

The knuckle hinge also offers a series of special solutions for particular requirements.

To achieve exceptional design, impeccable quality and visually expressive materials are needed. With a broad spectrum of different finish variants, VARIANT allows for maximum design freedom. In combination with currently popular, RAL and special colours, the hinge system features a wide range of premium finishes – from tone-to-tone blends to high-contrast options, from matt to very glossy, from standard to exceptional.

With its subtle knuckle hinge technology, the VARIANT hinge system looks impressive on both residential and heavy-duty doors. Being finely crafted components, knuckle hinges seamlessly integrate into any architectural style. Thanks to their maintenance-free slide bearings, they excel when used on heavy-duty doors, meeting requirements in terms of load capacity and the frequency with which they are used.

For more demanding structural requirements, the VARIANT VX heavy-duty range offers knuckle hinges for loads of up to 400 kg on timber, steel and aluminium frames. With a welded hinge knuckle, the hinge system is suitable for rebated and unrebated, heavy-duty commercial doors and, optionally, for fire, smoke and sound-proof doors.

With the special VARIANT Care hinge system, planned frame dimensions are turned into real clearance dimensions, as the door can be completely opened at a 90° angle from the frame passage. Suitable for use on timber, steel, and aluminium frames, the hinge system streamlines logistics within healthcare buildings. For this purpose, the knuckle hinges are designed for alternative door leaf thicknesses from 40 to 70 mm.

The location of the Humboldt Forum in Berlin is steeped in history. Recently put together by Italian architect Franco Stella, the crucial aspect was the fusion of old and new elements. The museum’s access areas and entrances experienced particularly heavy loads, which SIMONSWERK is able to effectively support using hinges from the VARIANT VX series, among other solutions.

The hinge system for timber entrance doors

Timber is a renewable raw material that is being used more and more frequently and in different ways in architecture. Timber is particularly suitable for entrance doors, as it perfectly combines meeting the demanding requirements for functionality, security and sturdiness with a sophisticated design. Using the tried-and-tested BAKA hinge system for timber entrance doors, SIMONSWERK provides a wide range of solutions in order to integrate high-quality timber front doors and entrance doors in private properties as well as public buildings.

Both series from the BAKA Protect brand are optimally adapted to the requirements of current rebated geometries which feature slim leaf profiles. Their 2D and 3D adjustability ensures they are perfectly fastened on while making assembly straightforward. The comprehensive choice of possible surface finishes provides the finishing touch in a wide range of buildings and contributes to the aesthetic appeal.
For rebated, unrebated and flush-rebated entrance door for load capacities up to 160 kg.
For load capacities on slim leaf geometries up to 120 kg with 2D adjustment.
Models with 2- and 3-part hinges allow adaptations to be made on a case-by-case basis.
Even timber windows can be conveniently fitted thanks to BAKA with 2- and 3-part hinges.

The hinge systems from the BAKA Protect 4000 3D series for rebated, flush-rebated and unrebated entrance doors can bear loads up to 160 kg. The convenient 3D adjustment allows the height and compression to be adjusted by +/- 3 mm to the side. If desired, all designs can be equipped with a security pin (MSTS) as additional protection for outwards opening entrance doors.
concealed receiver in door leaf and frame
can be used for system testing in accordance with DIN EN 1627 et seq.

The BAKA Protect 2000 2D model is principally designed for slim leaf geometries, and the milling work is minimal. The timber entrance door hinge has a load capacity of 120 kg, where side and compression adjustments of +/- 3.0 mm can be made. Besides the straightforward two-dimensional adjustability, the hinge system features tried-and-tested slide bearings
for load capacities up to 120 kg

2- and 3-part hinges and drill-in hinges for rebated timber doors. Different models with load capacities from 60 kg to 100 kg allow adaptations to blind frames and block frames to be made on a case-by-case basis

The 2- and 3-part hinges and drill-in hinges for timber windows make for a harmonious appearance with the door. The model variants have a wide range of surface finishes – gold-plated and galvanised – and different head shapes which can be used both on blind frames as well as block and casing frames. The hinges are suitable for tilting and rotary wings. For tilting wings, it is recommended to use an additional security pin (MSTS).

The highlight of the models from the BAKA Protect 4000 series for rebated, flush-rebated and unrebated entrance doors is their high load capacities which go up to 160 kg. With a concealed receiver in the door leaf and frame, they’re also available with an overlap seal.
greater load capacities up to 160 kg
internal hinge pin and optional security pin (MSTS) for outwards opening doors

‘Berliner hinges’ from the BAKA brand are principally designed for renovation work in listed buildings. With both the 2- and 3-part weld-on hinges, the various designs have visually appealing knuckle hinge head shapes which make for architectural highlights on different timber doors and windows. All these hinges are also available with coloured powder-coated finishes.

The BAKA Protect 4000 hinge system is designed for different reference values in terms of milling set-back, sealing measurement and compression adjustment. The complete theoretical adjustment path must be achieved on the basis of these reference values, which can vary in practice. The 3D comfortable eccentric adjustment for timber entrance doors allows the height and compression to be adjusted by +/- 3 mm to the side.

The hinge system for PVCu entrance doors

SIMONSWERK has developed SIKU as a hinge system to specifically meet the requirements of PVCu entrance doors. The brand offers screw-on hinges with rounded edges and coordinated knuckle diameters as well as hinge systems with a beautiful knuckle diameter design made of stainless steel, among other materials. The perfect combination of security, insulation and aesthetics.

Specifically using PVCu entrance doors, burglary prevention and insulation systems can be implemented in a visually pleasing way. The requirements for entrance doors in these areas have steadily increased over the last few years. PVCu can be seamlessly combined with attractive glass elements and is a light base material with excellent insulating properties. Regardless of whether you’re dealing with a light or heavy front door, the various hinge solutions from the SIKU brand can be adapted to specific designs, which always serves to ensure a harmonious overall aesthetic.
Hinge system with knuckle hinge aesthetic without interruption in the acoustic seal
For particularly heavy PVCu entrance doors with greater load capacities up to 160 kg.

Concealed hinge systems for residential doors

The extensive range of ANSELMI hinge systems offers high quality solutions for light interior doors. The concealed hinge systems are suitable mostly for interior residential doors as well as for internal doors up to 80 kg. Available in different model versions and a variety of finishes, they meet the highest requirements and offer functionality and timeless elegance to the door. All hinges of the product brand are 3D adjustable and have maintenance-free slide bearing technology which guarantees comfortable and long-lasting operation.

The ANSELMI portfolio offers different model versions for special requirements. Especially for minimalist design, which increasingly determines architecture with clear forms and restrained design, the models of the ANSELMI product brand for doors with a reduced hinge frame part and recessed frame facings of 12 – 14 mm as well as for unrebated doors offer optimal possibilities.
Model versions for unrebated residential doors from 40 kg to 80 kg.
Model versions for doors with recessed frame facings from 12 mm to 14 mm.
Model versions for doors with reduced hinge frame part.
Model versions with integrated closing function.

The ANSELMI hinge systems for unrebated residential doors are completely concealed. There are versions for timber and aluminium framed doors with load capacities up to 80 kg and an opening angle up to 180°. The ideal choice for elegant room concepts.
For doors with recessed frame facings

Thanks to the ANSELMI FVZ models the door frame can disappear behind a drywall or woodwork leaving just the essence of the door visible to the eyes. Especially for minimalist design, which increasingly determines architecture with clear forms and restrained design these versions offer optimal design possibilities.
For unrebated residential doors with a reduced hinge frame part

Model versions with reduced hinge frame part allow the installation of frame architrave without any additional operation on-site, while the central milling on the door panel offers a complete reversibility of the door, that can be used for left and right as well as for inward and outward opening. Like all hinges from ANSELMI this model is completely concealed and three-dimensionally adjustable.
Hinge systems with integrated closing function

The ANSELMI SC self-closing hinge system offers additional comfort. Thanks to a damper, installed inside the system, the door rotates with a controlled and constant speed until it closes. Fully integrated inside the hinge, ANSELMI SC is invisible when the door is mounted, preserving an overall clean and elegant aesthetic. The closing force, adjustable frontally and with the door installed, can be set individually and easily according to the needs and  adjusted if necessary.

The ANSLEMI hinges are available in an extensive range of 13 architectural finishes. The Satin Nickel and Aluminium Chrome finishes in combination with materials such as light oak lend any room an inviting and modern atmosphere. With the trend colors Black and Rustic Umber we respond to the increased demand for dark finishes, thus supporting a harmonious overall concept in door design.
AN 164 3D FVZ 12/38 - Hinge system for residential doors with recessed frame facings

The AN 164 3D FVZ 12/38 model version enables the frame facing to be set back by 12 mm. The frame part is offset to the sash part which makes it possible to integrate a door with a fully concealed hinge into the surrounding wall without any visible frame. The model version is suitable for load capacities up to 60 kg and is available in 13 aesthetic finishes.
AN 172 3D - Hinge system for unrebated residential doors with claddings

The hinge system AN 172 3D is suitable for unrebated 38-45 mm residential doors with claddings up to 4 mm. In addition, the hinge system has the hinge frame part reduced to 21 mm. Like all hinges from ANSELMI this model is completely concealed and three-dimensionally adjustable.

The complete system for steel and aluminium doors

The ALPRO hinge system for aluminium doors is a complete system that includes impressive features, from subtle knuckle hinges to concealed hinges. Using tried-and-tested heavy-duty hinge technology, SIMONSWERK has developed this unique system in close cooperation with the system suppliers of aluminium profiles. As a result, it’s suitable for a broad spectrum of different aluminium hollow chamber systems. The system is an optimal solution for permanently supporting even heavy doors and doors with high and wide dimensions and fire and smoke protection doors in their positions.
From knuckle hinges to concealed hinges

As the appearance of entrance, residential and heavy-duty doors influences the entire structure of the space, the ALPRO hinge system from SIMONSWERK offers models with sophisticated knuckle hinges as well as completely concealed hinges. This means that a consistent, perfectly coordinated appearance can always be achieved, regardless of the system profile and furnishing style.

The ALPRO hinge system for aluminium doors is a complete system that includes impressive features, from sophisticated knuckle hinges to concealed hinges. Thanks to bespoke hinge solutions, there is a broad spectrum for aluminium hollow chamber systems. Using tried-and-tested heavy-duty hinge technology, SIMONSWERK has developed this unique system in close cooperation with the system suppliers of aluminium profiles – with a visually appealing design for sophisticated room concepts.

The key features of all ALPRO hinge models are outstanding functionality, convenient 2D and 3D adjustability, sturdy fastenings and a wide variety of combinations for creating many different profile combinations. The system is an optimal solution for permanently supporting even heavy doors and doors with high and wide dimensions and fire and smoke protection doors in their positions.

In addition to its aesthetically pleasing design, the ALR insert knuckle hinge is intended for practical handling and is easy to assemble. The knuckle hinge can be easily and straightforwardly integrated into the frame, allowing the adjusting mechanism to completely disappear in the blind frame. The adjustment options and the continuous seal on opening profile systems are particularly convenient.

With direct screw connections, the fastening system for ALRPO hinges provides optimal security. Thanks to the flexible design, the FS 10 anchor can be used on one side and undetachably in different profile widths. The threaded sleeve is screwed on with the thread pin and the FS 10 anchor is then screwed into the system profile. This screwing action anchors the thread pin in the borehole of the hollow profile opposite and sinks the sleeve without protruding in the profile.
The FS 10 anchor is screwed into the system profile.
By screwing the sleeve in, the thread pin is anchored in the borehole of the hollow profile opposite.
The threaded sleeve is screwed in the profile until the collar and provides optimal security in terms of fastening thanks to the connection to the thread pin.
You can have a consultation directly with your personal contact partner to discuss products and bespoke systems.

The self-closing knuckle hinge system for doors

The beautifully designed EVO knuckle hinge is the hinge for doors that open in one direction. Thanks to the hydraulics housed in the knuckle, the highlight of the self-closing hinge is its reduced design which maximises the effect of the door leaf. It’s suitable for indoor and outdoor spaces protected against driving rain.
Sophisticated visual design for a range of applications

In upmarket residential buildings, offices and administrative buildings and many other areas, the EVO knuckle hinge system offers reliability and aesthetic quality down to the smallest details. EVO separates specific areas from one another effectively and allows glass doors to close securely and in a controlled manner.

EVO for rebated glass hinges is a hinge with adjustable closing and constant brake control which is suitable for all door opening angles up to 180° and is also available as a version with automatic closing from 160° to 0°. It’s equipped with a shock absorber that has integrated overlap relief and prevents breakage caused by accidental tugging.

The aluminium EVO hinge is versatile in how it’s used as well as in its finishes. Whether anodised or coated, matted or polished, the hydraulic knuckle hinge produces a unique effect in black, grey, chrome, or bronze as well as many other colours.
The first choice for residential buildings and offices

EVO is mainly installed in office and administrative buildings. But this hinge is also excellently suited to separating specific areas in medical practices or upmarket residential buildings, such as large apartments with a lot of square footage. EVO is even used in saunas and many other areas.

EVO has integrated hydraulic damping which ensures the closing process is gentle and controlled and prevents the door repeatedly oscillating around the zero position. The doors can optionally be equipped with door push handles or a latch lock and strike box. The latch of the lock is retracted quietly and reliably into the striker plate, preventing damage to glass, hinges and locks as well as noise. Thanks to an infinitely variable regulator on the hinge, it’s possible to adapt the closing speed to any door weight or width and to the user walking speed on a case-by-case basis.

The hydraulic hinges are patent-protected worldwide. They have been tested in accordance with EN 1154:2006 specifications and are certified by TÜV Süd. The effectiveness of the hinges is greater than traditional door closers (90% compared to 60%). The doors can be opened manually with little force and close automatically at the set speed. So it makes sense to install hydraulic hinges wherever the controlled self-closing of doors is required by law or for technical reasons.
Plus points relevant to building owners:
energy-saving in heated or air-conditioned rooms
visual and physical separation of rooms

The self-closing pivot hinge system for doors

VERTO, the self-closing hinge system for pivot glass doors, ensures doors are closed in an automatic, constant and controlled way with adjustable speed. The hinges are purist in design and are suitable for quick and easy installation in any environment.
For elegant room concepts with plenty of natural light

VERTO combines technical efficiency and innovation in an exclusive hinge system used in many high-quality projects, such as sophisticated interior concepts and sheltered outdoor areas, where VERTO creates maximum transparency between the interior and exterior. The minimalist pivot hinge ensures elegance and quiet, controlled door movement even when used on oversized, heavy glass doors.
SIMONSWERK's first pivot hinge system for wood applications.

With the VERTO VT 107E WD, SIMONSWERK introduces its first self-closing pivot hinge system designed specifically for high-quality wood doors in the residential sector, extending our portfolio with the pivot door principle beyond large-format entrances.
Fully concealed once installed, it keeps the door leaf as a clean, uninterrupted surface while the hinge system recedes visually into the background.
Suited for door leaf thicknesses of 35 to 60 mm, it carries doors up to 80 kg and 1,000 mm wide, with a factory pre-set hydraulic self-closing function for smooth, controlled closing.
With an integrated self-closing function and load capacities up to 150 kg
The pivot hinge system for residential timber doors

For heavy glass swing doors with an integrated self-closing function, an elegant, minimalist design and load capacity of up to 150 kg. Shock absorbers and an exceptionally robust braking function allow the door to be opened and closed smoothly and quietly, with precise control.
load capacity up to 150 kg, max. door width 1200 mm
glass thicknesses from 8 mm to 19.5 mm
model variants for inside and outside doors
For double-action residential doors up to 80 kg
Kit of hydraulic bottom hinge and top hinge with pivot

The VERTO pivot hinge offers a wide selection of finishes, allowing the room to give off the desired impression. Polished bright bronze is the preferred choice of colour for emphasising particular elements, whereas matt stainless steel or finely polished finishes are suitable for a more understated appearance.

Elegance, flexibility and design freedom are the characterising elements of VERTO’s untainted appearance, which make the hinges perfect for installing in any environment, whether indoors or outdoors. These hinges enhance the premium quality of the architectural concept with authentic glass door leaf material. The different variants are used on doors in residential buildings and on heavy-duty doors, always ensuring the door closes in a controlled manner. The portfolio also comprises completely concealed hinges for flush room structures, such as in shopping centres, offices and commercial buildings

Using pivot doors, the hinges are fitted almost invisibly at the top and bottom instead of on the sides, which facilitates smooth, controlled door movement into the room and back again. Depending on the installation situation, flush installation can be achieved without a frame. Another benefit of pivot doors is the ability to achieve the desired dimensions, for both inside and outside doors.

The screw-on hinge system for glass doors

The COLLIO screw-on hinge was designed for doors with frames and dividing walls and is the solution for double-action and rebated doors with dampers. Its well thought-out functionality and simple appearance make the hinge a reliable and elegant detail in interior rooms.
High-quality glass doors deserve to be fitted with equivalent hinges designed for a long life. The COLLIO hinge is the perfect and sustainable complement to glass doors in elegant surroundings.
COLLIO Final latch - with end stop
COLLIO Final latch - with end stop

The COLLIO Final latch hinge is designed for use on double-action and rebated doors. Closing starts at 40° – with central or offset all-glass assembly or central glass-glass assembly. The shape of the fastening leaf ensures a reliable seal in the hinge area. To open, just pull.
max. door width up to 900 mm

The aluminium COLLIO Free hinge is available as a type for narrow profiles and a rounded type for profiles from 30 mm to 42 mm. The latter was designed for glass doors in offices, shops and apartments; thanks to its linear and square shapes, the version for narrow profiles is suitable for various types of interior doors.

COLLIO hinges in the elegant stainless steel and matt black finishes are harmonious complements to glass doors in the most varied environments. Matt black in particular can develop its impressive effect in puritanical rooms or become restrained to the benefit of the impact of other colours.
For lightweight doors in the residential sector

COLLIO hinges have been developed for lightweight residential doors that need a self-closing function. They are particularly suitable for use in bathrooms, for example on shower dividers, or changing rooms, for example in shopping centres. They can also be combined with magnetic locks.
SIMONSWERK - It all hinges on excellence.
The self-closing screw-on hinge system for glass doors

The original for double-action and rebated doors: The BILOBA screw-on hinge has an automatic self-closing function thanks to the integrated hydraulic damping. Patent-protected worldwide and tested in over a million opening cycles, the hinge’s adjustable closing speed can be perfectly adapted to the user’s needs.
Bespoke support for transparent room concepts

Thanks to the adjustability of the closing speed, BILOBA is the first choice for sophisticated buildings which need doors to close in a gentle and controlled manner. The doors can be opened manually with little force and automatically close at the set speed. With BILOBA, you can account for a range of door weights, door widths and user walking speeds. Moreover, the hinge is ideal for cases where controlled self-closing is mandatory.
BILOBA hinges for glass double-action hinge come with different finishes and are suitable for wall-glass assembly (central and offset) and central glass-glass assembly.
The self-closing hinge system for rebated glass doors is suitable for offset wall-glass assembly. A range of finishes makes it possible to coordinate with the overall architectural design.
Variety for successfully setting the scene

BILOBA is available in different high-quality finishes which allow the screw-on hinge to be aesthetically coordinated, for example, in matte-gold or black for an eye-catching look. Even more finishes allow for a conspicuous or subtle appearance – it’s completely up to you.

Due to a large finish variety and an individualised, visually high-quality design, this classic hinge is suitable for a wide range of applications. This hinge is used in office and administrative buildings, showrooms, museums and upmarket culinary establishments.

BILOBA has an integrated, hydraulic damping which ensures the closing process is gentle and controlled and prevents the door oscillating around the zero position. The doors can optionally be equipped with door push handles or a latch lock and strike box. The latch of the lock is retracted quietly and reliably into the striker plate, preventing damage to glass, hinges and locks as well as noise. Thanks to an infinitely variable regulator on the hinge, it’s possible to adapt the closing speed to a range of door weights, door widths and user walking speeds on a case-by-case basis.

The hydraulic hinges are patent-protected worldwide. They have been tested in accordance with EN 1154:2006 specifications and are certified by TÜV Süd. The effectiveness of the hinges is greater than traditional door closers (90% compared to 60%). The doors can be opened manually with little force and close automatically at the set speed. So it makes sense to install hydraulic hinges wherever the controlled self-closing of doors is required by law or for technical reasons.

The innovative, zero-current magnetic KEEP CLOSED latching system makes opening and closing doors silent and as comfortable as possible. Consisting of a closing magnet, magnetic plate and matching handles, the system has a reduced design and its components are perfectly coordinated.
Ideal for timber and glass doors
KEEP CLOSED was designed to be used on both timber and glass doors and provides an intelligent alternative to conventional latching systems for both door types.
KEEP CLOSED for residential glass doors

Glass doors can be easily and gently opened and closed using the magnetic KEEP CLOSED closing system. The ergonomic handles fit discreetly and unobtrusively onto the glass door leaf. This, combined with the concealed TECTUS Glass hinge system, makes for a thoroughly minimalist appearance.

The magnetic latching system for glass doors boasts unique advantages – it’s zero-current, maintenance-free and wear-free and works silently. This makes glass doors easy to operate and they retain their elegant, reduced design.

KEEP CLOSED for timber residential doors

KEEP CLOSED allows timber residential doors to be moved completely silently with minimal ergonomic effort and without the usual ‘push-pull-slide’ motion. The door is held in the closed position without the need for direct contact with the patented closing magnet. The retention force can be individually adjusted and holds the door securely in its end position.

Zero-current, silent, wear-free and functionally reliable: The technical properties of KEEP CLOSED are impressive in every aspect. This is also includes the excellent operating comfort provided by the especially easy opening and closing of the doors.

The closing magnet, magnetic plate and handles are perfectly coordinated with one another and have a sleek, reduced design. While the KCM 50 closing magnet, in combination with the KCM 50/H magnetic plate, is perfect for use on timber block and casing frames, the KCH 1700 handle can be easily fastened using a positioning template.
